item.title: Vallejo man on trial for Antioch killing
item.description: ANTIOCH — Hours before Jesus Soto shot and killed Richard Morello Jr. outside a home in southeast Antioch, the two appeared by the Antioch’s waterfront together to participate in a music video for a local rapper. Later, on the 200 block of Cobblestone Drive, at least four to five people, including Morello, apparently became displeased with Soto, of Vallejo, and kicked him out of the home. item.title: Vallejo City Council approves $11 million road paving, homeless stipend
item.description: The $11 million will fund upgrading curb ramps to Americans with Disabilities Act standards, cape seal treatments for residential streets, and mill and overlay treatments for arteries and collector roadways. Work is expected to start in summer-fall 2026.
